title: Glamour Melon (Glamour F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Glamour melon is a melon variety from Allied Botanical. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Glamour is a melon variety, also sold or known as Glamour F1 or Glamour muskmelon. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical.

heroImage.alt: Ampalaya seedlings planted through plastic mulch on raised beds, the kind of farm where Glamour melon is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Glamour F1 or Glamour muskmelon, this is the same melon. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [melon variety finder](/crop-varieties/melon), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for gourds and melons](/land-preparation/cucurbit-land-preparation).

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest 57 to 58 days after flowering. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit melon fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest 57 to 58 days after flowering.
**Fruit:** Very uniform round netted fruit, orange flesh, 1.5 to 2.5 kg, about 14 percent brix.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: Allied Botanical product page only, melons are not in Allied's current cucurbit category list, so present availability is unconfirmed. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual melon on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Glamour melon

Muskmelon and honeydew need dry weather near harvest, or the fruit cracks and loses its sweetness. Plant so that the fruit ripens before the rains. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Glamour F1 the same as Glamour?
items.a: Yes. Glamour F1 is another name for Glamour. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Glamour?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
